Subject: AegisAI - logging/redaction for prompts containing PII

Alex,

If our prompts occasionally contain end-user PII, how does Redwood handle that in logs? Do you support automatic redaction or hashing?

Were not asking you to store prompts for us; we just want to avoid accidental exposure in any troubleshooting systems.

Thanks,
Dana

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Kline <dana.kline@aegisai.io>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Mar 4, 2025 at 9:18 AM
Subject: Re: AegisAI - logging/redaction for prompts containing PII

Hi Dana,

We recommend customers avoid sending sensitive identifiers where possible or apply client-side redaction/tokenization. Redwood does not provide a general-purpose PII redaction layer inside the hosted API today.

For hosted, we have limited retention of request/response payloads for debugging/abuse prevention with strict access controls. We can share our standard statement and SOC 2 details under NDA.

Regards,
Olga
